description.value: Akari is a Japanese restaurant in Delta's Scott 72 Centre that has been serving fine Japanese cuisine since 1996 and is consistently voted best Japanese restaurant in the neighbourhood. The menu spans sushi and rolls, tempura prepared by a 20-year tempura master, rice and noodle dishes, and a dedicated vegetarian section. Online ordering for pickup and delivery is available, and the restaurant also handles catering and private events.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at deltaakari.com is live and corroborates the OSM address (7261 120 St, Delta, BC V4C 6P5) and supplies a phone number absent from OSM tags. Takeout is confirmed via explicit 'Order Pickup' and 'Order Delivery' buttons on the site; a dedicated 'vegetarian' menu category confirms plant-based options; washrooms are confirmed by a customer review stating 'sit in booths are impeccably clean as are the washrooms.' No bike-specific amenities (racks, pump, Wi-Fi, device charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM tags contain no phone number; phone (604) 590-1192 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, established, publicly accessible restaurant open since 1996 with a live website, confirmed address, and active online ordering.
